decision: Support exploratory water-to-spring-wheat linkage using the published sampling design plus exact biomass plot bridges; soil-nitrogen plot IDs are not a water identity key

published_sampling_design.short_excerpt: within the spring wheat response crop strip
published_sampling_design.verification_limit: Methods excerpt inspected in indexed primary-paper text. Direct university PDF download returned HTTP 403; no full-PDF visual verification is claimed. The provider files independently verify the biomass-to-wheat plot bridge.

identity_rule: Match soil water EXPYEAR+2008 to response-crop YEAR, and REP/CCTRT to REP/TRT. Verify each year/rep/treatment against both releases' cover-year biomass PLOT IDs using biomass YEAR+1. Those IDs must equal the spring-wheat PLOT. Never derive a constant plot-number offset or transfer water to other response crops.
limits: Water file omits raw plot IDs; linkage is supported by published sampling design and biomass identities, not a direct water-PLOT equality check or author confirmation.
Soil-nitrogen PLOT IDs disagree and remain unverified for response-crop linkage; do not import nitrate via this bridge.
Use the soil-study AGBIOMASS kg/ha column only; do not merge or reconcile species-component biomass amounts from the other release without a separate unit audit.
Water is stored water at seven 30-cm layers to 210 cm, in cm per layer. Convert cm to mm by ten. It is not verified PAW.
PREPLANT is before cover seeding, not before wheat sowing. SPRING has no exact per-row sampling date and is not an exact wheat-sowing observation.
The catalog's 2011 spring endpoint and wheat planting date differ by a day; do not invent row-level sample ordering from phase labels.
New land was used across years within the Mandan area; the catalog's three site coordinates are not assigned to years here.
This is spring wheat at Mandan in 2009-2011, kept separate from Colorado winter wheat. No model fitting or production promotion is authorized by linkage eligibility alone.
